mechanism.claim: A large completed USDMXN move during the liquid London-to-New-York overlap is a global cyclical-risk repricing: peso strengthening denotes risk appetite and peso weakening denotes risk aversion. During elevated BTC variation, BTC should relay in the same canonical risk direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the completed USDMXN session return
mechanism.why_distinct: Dollar breadth requires five-of-six common USD moves; the failed safe-haven/cyclical barbell requires simultaneous opposite canonical signs across four currencies. HVMXRR uses one predeclared liquid cyclical currency's own causal shock tail at one fixed session close, with no cross-sectional breadth, cancellation, BTC return direction, crypto price, flow, volume, funding, OI, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing BTC 24-hour realized variation at the decision must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one weekday 21:05 UTC external-FX shock clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.fx_session: exact observed bars_polygon USDMXN one-minute rows during weekday [13:00,21:00) UTC
features.session_valid: at least 450 distinct minutes, first no later than 13:05, last no earlier than 20:55, finite positive coherent OHLC; no imputation
features.session_return: log(last close/first open), finite strict nonzero
features.shock_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute session_return over at most 90 prior valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC perpetual one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 prior source-valid weekday decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 21:00 UTC after FX session and BTC variation complete
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT perpetual D 21:05 UTC open
clock.reservation: fixed weekday decisions; global chronological half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent external cyclical-currency risk transmission mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no currency, session, validity, history, shock rank, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
